## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue/ticket.

## Validation

Record commands/results and OS/device evidence for native changes. Synthetic
screenshots/examples only.

## Privacy and risks

Describe effects on network, logging, clipboard, storage, lifecycle, restoration
or image export. Link an ADR for architecture/privacy changes. List pending checks.

- [ ] PR targets dev (or is a maintainer promotion to stage/main).
- [ ] Followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the privacy/module contracts.
- [ ] Updated meaningful tests and documentation where needed.
- [ ] Added HANDOFF files/checks/assumptions/risks.
- [ ] No real PII, credentials, generated models, installers or local SDK recovery.
